source: Esri World Imagery, Maxar Vivid capture 2023-03-01 (0.31 m source), resampled to 0.5 m and warped to survey coordinates; rule-based classification (excess-green, colour ratios, brightness, local texture)
rules: Inputs smoothed with Gaussian sigma 1 px (0.5 m). Features per pixel: br=(R+G+B)/3; nExG=100*(2G-R-B)/(R+G+B); gr=100*(G-R)/(R+G+B); rb=100*(R-B)/(R+G+B); tex=std of br in 5x5 px; texm=mean tex in 11x11 px (5.5 m); texL=mean tex in 41x41 px (20.5 m); d=br minus mean br in 15x15 px (7.5 m). VEG: nExG>=8.0 and 55.0<br<200.0, except dark weakly-green pixels (br<72.0 and nExG<12.0) treated as shadow. TREES (within VEG): crown seeds d<-4.0 and br<95.0, grown by 2 px into VEG pixels with d<0.0 and br<95.0; plus closed canopy br<80.0 and texm>=4.5; plus very dark canopy br<72.0 and gr<7.0 (dark meadow is greener, gr>7). GRASS: VEG not TREES (tree pieces dropped for size also become GRASS). ROOF mask (excluded from BARE, dilated 2 px): (gr<-5.5 or rb>14.0) and br>=110.0, or rb>19.0. BARE: not VEG, not ROOF, rb>=7.0, texm<12.0, texL<9.5, built-up density<0.2 (share of pixels in 41x41 px window that are bright roof-coloured gr<-4.5 & br>=110.0, very bright br>190, or dark non-green br<70 & nExG<6), and either light soil 100.0<=br<=215.0, gr>-5.5, rb<=14.0 or dark/ploughed soil 70.0<=br<110.0, gr>-8.0, rb<=19.0. OTHER: everything else; one pond in the zone (~1,200 m2 around survey x 31220, y 30705) was masked by hand (seeded region grow) as water/other because it read as dark canopy. Cleaning per class (priority trees>grass>bare): binary open then close with 3x3 cross (~1 m), drop 8-connected pieces <20 m2 (trees) / <50 m2 (grass, bare), fill holes <10 m2. Vectorised on pixel edges (4-connected), Douglas-Peucker 1.1 m (raised from 0.5 m to keep JSON under 4 MB; 0.5 m gave 7.7 MB), coords rounded to 0.1 m, outer rings CCW, holes CW, rings not closed (first point not repeated).
